prompt: Write a 6510 machine-language routine, callable from BASIC with SYS 49152, that fills the C64 text screen with character code 81 (the ball). Show the assembly and how to enter and call it.
assertions: Loads #81 into A and stores across the 1000 bytes of screen RAM at $0400-$07E7
Ends the routine with RTS to return to BASIC
The screen-fill loop is correct (covers all 1000 cells, e.g. 4 pages via an index loop)
